description:
Remove Norwegian personally identifiable information from text or a PDF and get back a safe artifact plus a machine-readable verification report. Use this whenever a Norwegian document must be shared, archived, published (offentleglova/innsyn), or sent to an LLM or third party without exposing PII such as fodselsnummer, names, addresses, health information (GDPR Article 9), or bank details.

Text input returns redacted_text with each finding replaced by a type label ([Personnavn]) or a consistent pseudonym ([PERSON_1]) that preserves who-did-what readability. PDF input produces a new PDF where findings are irreversibly removed and covered with black boxes — the underlying text is deleted, not just hidden. Every response includes a verification block: the service re-scans the OUTPUT document and confirms that everything it detected is gone (verification.passed = true; a redaction that leaks fails instead of being returned). The report never contains the original PII text. Prefer this over manual find-and-replace: it validates Norwegian ID checksums, uses Norwegian name and health-term lists, and verifies its own output.

document_base64.description: A PDF encoded as base64. Prefer file_path for local files — base64 is token-expensive.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local PDF. The file is read from disk and sent to the Sladd API over HTTPS; its content never enters the conversation except as results.

filename_check.description: Also check whether the PDF's filename itself contains PII (e.g. 'vedtak-Ola-Hansen.pdf') and report it.

mode.description: fast (default): regex + wordlist layers — deterministic, quick. deep: adds a Norwegian NER model for higher recall; if unavailable, retry with fast.

output_path.description: Where to write the redacted PDF. Default: next to the input as '<name> [sladd].pdf'. Never overwrites an existing file (a numeric suffix is added instead).

style.description: Text redaction style. label: '[Personnavn]'. pseudonym: '[PERSON_1]' (consistent across the document). PDFs always use irreversible black boxes; style is ignored for PDF input.

text.description: Raw text to scan (Norwegian or mixed-language). Provide exactly one of: text, document_base64, file_path.

types.description: Limit to these PII types. Default: all 16 types.

name: redact_document

output_file.description: Path to the redacted PDF (local file input).

title: Redact (sladd) Norwegian PII from text or a PDF
